body:
We should try to support multi-references:

```
(some example: some example is a link)
```

```
some example
```

And also we should switch to arrays for both `id` and `values`.

That means if we have defined any multi references in the file, it means we should treat `some example` in any places as single multi-reference.

So in that example we have multi-reference definition, and also multi-reference as a self reference for that link.

We need to try implement these feature in all supported languages, with the same set of tests.
title: Support multiple references as single reference
